children: The new Aave App enters early access, opening the retail savings product to a wider audience. US users can skip the waitlist by using the Ghost Pass code EVERYSECOND while supplies last. The app is designed to channel user deposits into Aave's lending protocol.

Broadened access advances the app's adoption path, since waitlist removal lowers friction for US retail deposits that can flow into Aave's protocol. Deposit activity is the observable signal to track, because the product's effect on the protocol depends on usage that has not yet been demonstrated. Supplies for the code are limited, so early access remains partial rather than a full public launch.
Grow your money every single second with the world’s savings app. Now in early access.

title: Aave: App Early Access Opens to US Users via Ghost Pass - 18 Sep 2026
